Factual data from the text:
- The Titanic was a British passenger liner.
- It was operated by the White Star Line.
- It was on its maiden voyage from Southampton to New York City.
- It hit an iceberg on April 14, 1912.
- It sank in the North Atlantic Ocean.
- There were an estimated 2,224 passengers and crew aboard.
- More than 1,500 people died.
- It is considered one of the deadliest commercial peacetime maritime disasters in modern history.
